verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not equity-management or cap-table software. In-platform e-signing of SAFEs or convertible notes and cap-table conversion modeling fall outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships e-signature or cap-table features; generic file and document creation is unrelated.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled
